scope: Windows x64 MSVC Release fixed-work public Light-drain CPU comparison.
limits: This finite CPU result does not measure scene FPS, GPU work, loading or original-game parity.
Baseline uses the current local Windows simulation dependency closure after the Vector failure-PC correction, not the earlier f44895cb closure.
Both variants rebuild only queries.c and propagation.c. Every other simulation archive member and dependency library is shared byte for byte.
The production candidate sources are byte-identical to the measured private candidate. One compiled benchmark object links both variants.
Every original admission, provider presence, GET, lease and source query remains in order. No Chunk/provider binding is cached between calls.
No CPU affinity or scheduler controls. All raw samples and process ordering are retained. Initial and confirmation runs remain separate.
optimization: Read the four live provider bindings directly rather than build an unrelated full provider field view for each getter. Same provider identity/binding failure diagnostics and subsequent source operations.
